text:
Rosie (infra): Quick pulse — we need a preflight/readiness sync with Polaris for their Dedicated + VPC rollout. Asking who can join on infra/eng + CS to walk the runbook and validate network pre-reqs. Proposed slots: Thu 04/14 10:00-10:30 PT (:one:) or Fri 04/15 13:00-13:30 PT (:two:). Agenda draft: 1) runbook walkthrough, 2) firewall/subnet peering checks, 3) canary plan & metrics, 4) rollback criteria + fallback model, 5) key exchange/KMS handoff. Who will own the runbook walkthrough? cc @Sophia @Jamie @Raul

Jamie L.: I can run the walkthrough and cover the install steps. Prefer Thu (:one:). I'll bring the runbook link and a short demo of the bootstrap.

Sophia T.: Thu works for me too. Please ensure Polaris has shared their KMS key policy and the peering CIDR list beforehand — security needs those to validate. Added a short checklist to the doc: https://redwood.docs/polaris/preflight-checks

Raul G.: I'll own network/firewall checks and the canary metrics. Quick ask: can security confirm the final port list (eg. 443, 8443, 10250) and any non-standard egress? @security-squad

Marta (CS): I'll coordinate customer attendees and confirm time availability with Polaris PM. Polaris asked for a short dry-run of the canary traffic shape — we should include expected QPS and token sizes in the invite.

security-squad: Confirming we need the peering CIDRs + KMS ARN. For ports: allow 443, 8443, 10250, and 9000 for metrics; annotate any exceptions. We'll review the IAM policy in the sync.

Rosie (infra): Thanks. Two quick preflight asks for the customer before the meeting: 1) run `uname -a` and `ip -4 addr show` on the host(s), 2) provide a sample request body (size distribution) for canary. Example command we ask them to run: ```ssh ops@polaris-host 'uname -a; ip -4 addr show'``` or for NIC details: ```ssh ops@polaris-host 'sudo lshw -C network'```

Jamie L.: I'll attach the runbook snippet to the calendar invite and paste the bootstrap commands in the doc. Also prepping a 5-min slide to remind of rollback triggers.

Rosie (infra): Voting quickcheck: react :one: for Thu, :two: for Fri. If no objections by EOD PT we'll lock Thu 10:00 PT and send invites.

deploy-bot: Draft invite created -> https://calendar.redwood/meet/1965432100/polaris-readiness.ics (please review attendees)

Marta (CS): Polaris confirmed Thu 10:00 PT. I'll add their infra lead and product owner to the invite.

Raul G.: Pre-req: please add the canary metric dashboard link into the invite, I want everyone to have it open. I'll post it to the doc before the call.

Rosie (infra): Cool — locking Thu 04/14 10:00-10:30 PT. Action items: Jamie (runbook walkthrough), Raul (network + metrics), Sophia (security/KMS signoff), Marta (customer coordination). I'll update runbook link and attach the preflight commands. Meeting invite with agenda sent.

Jamie L.: Thanks — see you all Thu. :thumbsup:

Rosie (infra): End of thread.
